messages:
Alicia: Quick check — can we tweak the evening handoff cadence this week? I'll be OOO Tue PM. Proposal: 15-min bridge at 18:30 PST, quick async incident summary posted to #incidents by 19:00. Keep the same escalation order. Thoughts?

Mike: 18:30 PST works for me. Keep it tight 15m. If a P1 lands during the bridge, we escalate immediately and keep bridge open. :thumbsup:

Ravi: I can take Wed night. +1 to rotating escalation lead nightly so the same person isn't burned out.

Sophie: Heads up — 18:30 PST is late for APAC folks (09:30 AET next day). They asked not to be pinged unless critical. Can we capture a 1-line recording or transcript?

Jamal: I can be the escalation for Tue. For after-hours P1s (post-19:00) we should page primary, then secondary if no ack in 5. I'll update PD rotations after we confirm.

Alicia: Agreement plan:
- 18:30 PST bridge (15m max)
- If P1 during bridge -> follow immediate escalation, bridge stays open until triage
- Async summary + open incidents list by 19:00 in #incidents (one-liner per incident: status / owner / ETA)
- Nightly escalation lead rotates; Jamal covers Tue, Ravi Wed, Mike Thu (can volunteer for Fri)

Alicia: Scheduling note — calendar invite should have: Bridge link, runbook links, PD escalation order, and a small template. I'll paste the template below.

Alicia: TEMPLATE:
```
BRIDGE: <zoom-link>
INCIDENTS: post one-line items here
ESCALATION: primary (pager), secondary
OWNER: name
ETA: hh:mm
NEXT-STEPS: short
```

oncall-bot: Reminder: runbook for service-alpha -> https://redwood/runbooks/service-alpha (last updated 2026-02-12). Use the P1 checklist there.

Mike: Suggest adding a quick pre-bridge status ping 10m before (18:20) — short readout in thread: active alerts / expected deploys / known flakiness. Cuts down bridge chatter.

Sophie: +1 on pre-ping. Also add a line in the invite about APAC notification policy: "Only escalate APAC on P1s or with explicit opt-in".

Alicia: Good call. I'll send updated invite with agenda, pre-ping reminder, and the rotation table. Also will add the cron for automated async summary reminder in #incidents:
```
# cron (UTC): 01 01 02 * *  # placeholder, will convert to 19:00 PST
```

Ravi: FYI — I updated my oncall notes with the nightly checklist. Link: https://redwood/notes/oncall-ravi.

Jamal: If nobody objects I'll take responsibility to update the PD escalation order and post the calendar change. Otherwise speak now.

Mike: Fine by me. Thanks for owning it Jamal.

Sophie: OK from me.

Alicia: Thanks all. Action items: Jamal update PD & calendar, Alicia update invite + template + APAC note, Ravi add rotation to the oncall doc. We'll try this cadence Wed-Fri this week and iterate.

Mike: Sounds good.

oncall-bot: Scheduled reminder set for #incidents at 19:00 local (cron registered).

Alicia: I'll post a one-line post-bridge summary tonight as template example. :white_check_mark:
__notes: This thread is a short planning/coordination exchange about oncall handoff cadence and the agenda for evening incident triage bridges. Messages are intentionally concise to match Slack style.
